say.text: The last boats cross in the dark. On the landings, the Caliph's ally draws his riders off.
That was the last of them, and we are still standing. I count that a victory.
Count it again when Baghdad has answered.
Bihruz, the governor, was told what Ayyub had done and sent him a letter of blame.
You had our enemy in your power. Why did you treat him so well, and let him go?
He asks why. I have no better answer than the one I gave at the gate: the man had nothing left in his hands.
Then I will remind him what he owed our father.
